version.value: Bass solo with orchestra; Russian text by Alexander Pushkin
version.note: The performing orchestral edition is not identified. The song, No. 2, dates from 1897; the source collection’s blanket 1882 date belongs to No. 1.

performers.note: DAHR supplies the conductor; no ensemble identity is inferred.

matrixTakeSides.note: Internet Archive dates this pressing 1923; DAHR dates the Victor 6058 issue [1922]. Both precede the 1925 publication cutoff. The session was in 1921, not 1923. IA’s “6058B” matrix field is the issue side number, not the Gramophone matrix.

credits.note: The archive names the transfer operator and scanning centre, not the original recording engineer.

date.note: Upload dates are not treated as transfer dates.

processing.value: Transferred at 78 rpm. The preferred named FLAC uses a 3.3 mil truncated-conical stylus; turnover 0, rolloff 0; the streamed MP3 derives from that FLAC.
processing.note: Surface noise and transfer equalisation prevent absolute sound-quality or loudness comparisons.

digital.format: MP3 access derivative; one source file, no concatenation or audio edits by Contrapunctus

composition.value: Underlying song and Pushkin text are public domain under ordinary life-plus-70 terms
composition.note: Rimsky-Korsakov died in 1908 and Pushkin in 1837; the song was published in 1898. No rights in an unidentified modern edition are asserted.

recording.value: US public domain: sound recording published before the 1925 cutoff
recording.note: Internet Archive dates this pressing 1923; DAHR dates the Victor 6058 issue [1922]. Both precede the 1925 publication cutoff. The session was in 1921, not 1923. IA’s “6058B” matrix field is the issue side number, not the Gramophone matrix. No non-commercial licence is present in the inspected archive metadata.
